work.title: Me and Me (Jee)
work.description: Two naively drawn figural forms labeled 'ME' and 'ME (JEE)' stand against a blue and green painted background, with multiple gold compact discs distributed across the composition. Line-drawn figures include a smaller inverted figure at lower center, with hand-drawn flowers, hearts, and a small crown visible throughout.
work.composition: two central figures flanking vertical green stripes
